solo: Peça uma frase pessoal com 2 das palavras.

facts.label: Dizer há quanto tempo
facts.sub: Use have/has + particípio com for: It has leaked for three days. Para agora, use is + -ing: It is leaking. Para o início, use since.

facts.label: Há + período
facts.sub: Use for com uma quantidade de tempo: for three days, for a month, for years. Com o present perfect, a frase diz que algo começou e continua: It has leaked for three days. Não use o presente simples nesse caso.

facts.label: Desde + ponto no tempo
facts.sub: Use since com um ponto de partida: since Monday, since 2020. Ela has lived here since June. A pergunta é How long has it leaked? Responda com for ou since, conforme a ideia.

compare.ask: It has leaked for three days.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “a pia vaza há três dias”, com o verbo no presente.
compare.tip: Diga: “It has leaked for three days.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use o present perfect com for: The sink has leaked for three days. Use o present continuous para o que acontece agora: The sink is leaking.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: It has leaked for three days.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: For is used with a period of time, like for three days.
Since is used with a period: since three days.
items.why: Since is used with a starting point: since Monday.

items.s: It has leaked for days means it still leaks.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: For is used with a period of time, like for three days. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Since is used with a period: since three days. → Falso (Since is used with a starting point: since Monday.)
It has leaked for days means it still leaks. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A flat in Vancouver · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy morning in Vancouver. Max is standing in his kitchen with a bucket. The sink is leaking again, and the floor is wet. He has waited for three days. Rosa is the manager of the building. Max picks up the phone.
“Hello, Max. What’s the matter? You sound worried.” says Rosa. “The kitchen sink is leaking again. It has leaked for three days.” says Max. “Three days! Why haven’t you called me before?” says Rosa.
